findings.decision: Retain pax-std/lld/symbols: 431 candidate-only and 975 reference-only symbol records; bindings {'0': 431} versus {'0': 975}. Local/debug metadata may differ without changing execution, but this does not decide global or weak binding differences. Exact metadata equality remains unproved; no local-symbol class waiver.

findings.name: pax-std/lld/segments
findings.specification: ELF gABI edition 4.1 chapter 5, Program Header: PT_LOAD, p_flags, p_align; AMD64 ABI 1.0 section 5.1
findings.decision: Retain pax-std/lld/segments: candidate (type,flags,align) sequence [[1, 5, 4096], [1, 6, 4096], [7, 4, 8], [1685382481, 6, 16]] versus oracle [[1, 4, 4096], [1, 5, 4096], [1, 6, 4096], [1, 6, 4096], [6, 4, 8], [7, 4, 8], [1685382481, 6, 0], [1685382482, 4, 1]]. Two candidate LOAD segments intentionally combine read-only and executable content; the oracle has a separate read-only LOAD and GNU_RELRO. LLD also emits PHDR. Permission and segment-count equality is not established by equal execution; no layout waiver suppresses the record.

findings.name: pax-std/lld/relocations

facts.cause: retained per-site relocation records differ in identity, normalization or ordering; every candidate site is independently validated by the corpus gate

findings.specification: ELF gABI edition 4.1 chapter 4, Relocation: r_offset, r_info, r_addend; AMD64 ABI 1.0 (2025-03-12) sections 4.4 and 11
findings.decision: Retain pax-std/lld/relocations: 591948 candidate records versus 405217 oracle records. Original debug and relaxed sites remain individually retained by ligature; independent equations validated each output at ld02a. Different cardinalities preclude record equality; compact encoding changes neither relocation count nor target identity. Exact identity/ordering divergence is unresolved, not an optimization equivalence waiver.
